basic_info.description: Located on a quiet cul-de-sac, this charming feel good home has beautiful views over Glen Canyon from the living room, all three bedrooms, the deck and the garden.  The beautiful large living room has high ceilings, a fireplace and hardwood floors.  The very attractive formal dining room adjoins the vintage eat-in kitchen.  There are two bedrooms and one bath on the upper floor.  Behind the garage overlooking the garden is the third bedroom with a built-in desk and a generous sitting area. This bedroom has an ensuite bath. There is interior access from the garage.
